title: Neruda, Walcott, and Atwood Poets of the Americas

vibeProfile.oneLine: A critical guide to the poetry of Neruda, Walcott and Atwood.

summary: A critical study of three major poets of the Americas: Chile's Pablo Neruda, St Lucia's Derek Walcott and Canada's Margaret Atwood, whose work spans love, politics, history and the shaping of new-world identity. Prepared as a student's companion, it sets their poems in context and offers close readings across languages and traditions. A thoughtful scholarly introduction to three distinctive voices, two of them Nobel laureates, from across the vast and varied literature of the Americas.
whyReadIt: A scholarly guide to Neruda, Walcott and Atwood, three great and very different poets of the Americas.

funFacts.text: Both Neruda and Walcott won the Nobel Prize in Literature, in 1971 and 1992.
